GBPUSD trade setup:

Monthly on GBPUSD for me the bias is up, clearly pointing to the supply far up in the heavens.

DAILY: On the daily chart, price has been in an uptrend since July 2012, currently standing at a place from where it was rejected twice earlier, April 2012 and September 2012, Currently also, price is starting to project weakness, having been rejected for the third time in December.

Image 1: Daily linegraph for trendline and S/R flip. Black thick line is the S/R flip.

Image 2: Daily chart showing rejections of the price from the supply zone. The supply zone marked in green happens to be the Weekly and Daily supply zone.

Image 3: H4 chart. The take home message for me from this chart is break of the uptrend by the engulf of the source of the final upmove shown in light blue rectangle.

The white areas in the green zone are the untouched decisions made by the price to move lower.

Image4: M30 chart shows the decision made by the price to break the S/R line. Decision is marked in Golden color. The price is now compressing into the decision.

Image5: M5 chart helps us to zoom into the area where it was decided price is too expensive to go above the S/R flip and price moved further down.

Image 6: Target for the trade

In the event of the failure of the trade setup, the next setup would be to trade the untouched decision points shown on the H4 chart.

Advice and comments welcome!

July 2012 ستاپ معامله GBPUSD:

چارت ماهانهٔ GBPUSD: برای من بایاس صعودی است؛ کاملاً به عرضهٔ دوردست در آسمان‌ها اشاره می‌کند.

روزانه: در چارت روزانه، قیمت از ژوئیهٔ 2012 در روند صعودی بوده؛ الان در جایی ایستاده که قبلاً دو بار از آن رد شده، April 2012 و September 2012. الان هم قیمت شروع به نشان دادن ضعف کرده، چون در July برای سومین بار رد شد.

تصویر 1: خط‌گراف روزانه برای ترندلاین و S/R flip. خط ضخیم سیاه S/R flip است.

تصویر 2: چارت روزانه نشان‌دهندهٔ رد شدن قیمت از ناحیهٔ عرضه؛ ناحیهٔ عرضه‌ای که با سبز علامت خورده اتفاقاً همان ناحیهٔ عرضهٔ هفتگی و روزانه است.

تصویر 3: چارت H4. پیام کلیدی این چارت برای من، شکست روند صعودی با اینگالفِ مبدأ حرکت صعودی نهایی است که در مستطیل آبی‌روشن نشان داده شده.

نواحی سفید داخل ناحیهٔ سبز، تصمیم‌های لمس‌نشده‌ای هستند که قیمت برای حرکت پایین‌تر گرفته.

تصویر4: چارت M30 تصمیم قیمت برای شکست خط S/R را نشان می‌دهد؛ تصمیم با رنگ طلایی علامت خورده. قیمت الان دارد داخل تصمیم فشرده می‌شود.

تصویر5: چارت M5 به ما کمک می‌کند به ناحیه‌ای زوم کنیم که در آن تصمیم گرفته شد قیمت برای رفتن بالای S/R flip خیلی گران است و قیمت بیشتر پایین رفت.

تصویر 6: تارگت معامله

در صورت شکست ستاپ ترید، ستاپ بعدی، معامله نقاط تصمیمِ لمس‌نشده‌ای است که روی چارت H4 نشان داده شده‌اند.

Ans. I dont pay attention to single candle engulfings but I pay more attention to swing engulfings. If you understand the reason why I enter the trade then use it in reverse, and you will have my reason for exiting a trade.

When the price approaches to a significant demand or supply level belonging to higher time frames, I follow the price on m30, and when the last swing high/low gets engulfed, I exit. This is my way of trailing.

Now you can figure out why I did not close the trade on first of my charts.

On the gold trade, when price makes engulf of a level, it is more often than not going to the next level above or below, so I knew what I was targeting before I opened the trade. About price coming back in, it doesnt scare me because when I look up, it made a new engulfing, which clearly said to me, we are going up, if you want you can add another position at the point when price came down again

Hope this helps.

Hi Rex,

Here is the answer: If you see just below my entry, there is a blue rectangle, only partially visible. It says H1 FTR. The chart which you are looking at is an M5. You have a valid reasoning for going short on m5 when price comes back after making the engulf, but the problem is there is no HTF supply above it to support the engulf on the short side.

HTF tells you where the price is standing currently with respect to big players and LTF gives you entries. Try not to fixate on LTFs only coz you want to take more trades. Instead, go out to H4, daily, weekly, monthly and mark out each and every demand and supply which is created. wait for the price to come back to these zones and then watch the PA on LTFs. Then when you have the signal, trade it. By LTFs I dont mean M1,M5 but atleast H1 to get engulf, then pin point your entries on M5, M1 to enter the trade.

In short: "demand/supply H4 or higher, watch PA on return to these zones on M30/H1, got engulf, pin point your entries on M1/5/15. SL above the zone. Target, oppostite zone on the time frame on which you are taking the trade"

Good luck and keep the questions coming.
